zh: 新增日语五十音词库：新建词库对话框顶部多了「快速开始」一栏，点一下就能拿到 46 张卡片的平假名或片假名词库，不用逐个录入。每张卡正面是假名，背面是罗马字读音加一个例词（平假名配和语例词、片假名配外来语例词，两套音相同但例词不同），答案不印在正面；行名（あ行、か行……）作为词性标签显示，先把范围缩到五个音。假名的学习语言是日语，点朗读会用日语发音。片假名词库同样 46 张，与平假名一一对应。练习页按设计稿重整：页头横条与词库页共用同一套外壳，闪卡与测验入口各收成一句话说明，不再并排三个小方块重复侧栏已经在数的数字。
en: Japanese kana decks are here. The new-list dialog now opens with a Quick start section: one tap gives you a ready-made list of all 46 hiragana or all 46 katakana, no typing required. Each card shows the kana on the front and, on the back, its romaji plus an example word — hiragana decks pair with native Japanese words, katakana decks with loanwords, since the two scripts cover the same sounds but carry different vocabulary. The answer never appears on the question side. The row name (a-row, ka-row and so on) shows as the part-of-speech tag, narrowing the range to five sounds first. The deck's learning language is Japanese, so the speak button pronounces the kana in Japanese. The practice screen was rebuilt to match the design: its header strip now shares the word library's shell, and the flashcard and quiz entries each say what they are in one line instead of three little boxes repeating numbers the sidebar already counts.
